title: Prevention of Smoking Related Diseases
official: Integrated Primary and Secondary Prevention of Smoking Related Diseases With Low Dose CT Scan and Circulating Biomarkers, Coupled With Personalised Smoking Cessation Activity
summary: This is a prospective, observational, monocentric study. This study wants to test if among a smoking cessation intervention, behavioural counselling by video session is related to higher compliance and higher success rate than standard smoking cessation activity (face to face counselling).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Strong smokers (pack years \>= 20)
* Over or equal the age of 50
* Able to sign specific informed consent for the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not having plans to quit smoking
